 Follow Us On: News India Blast at Visakhapatnam oil refinery sends flames soaring, thick smoke engulfs area Blast at Visakhapatnam oil refinery sends flames soaring, thick smoke engulfs area
 A major explosion was reported at an oil refinery in Visakhapatnam with massive flames and thick smoke engulfing the area. The fire has since been brought under control, with no casualties or injuries reported.
 Advertisement Major explosion at HPCL refinery in Vizag; flames, thick smoke trigger panic (Screen grab: ITGD) By: Apoorva Jayachandran Visakhapatnam , Nov 2, 2026 23:54 IST Last Updated Nov 2, 2026 23:54 IST Published by Anuja Jha Nov 2, 2026 22:50 IST A major explosion was reported at the Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) refinery in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, triggering alarm among residents in the surrounding areas. The fire has since been brought under control, with no casualties or injuries reported so far.
 Visuals from the site showed flames shooting high into the air, while thick plumes of smoke engulfed the area. Residents were left alarmed as the fire raged at the refinery. 
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Malkapuram Circle Inspector E Narasimha Rao said the situation was under control and that HPCL fire personnel were taking measures to completely extinguish the flames using the facility's own fire engines. 
 He clarified that no loss of life or injuries had been reported so far. He also said there was no need to deploy external fire engines as HPCL's internal firefighting team was effectively bringing the situation under control.
